question: Which city won the UN-Shanghai Global Award for its sustainable urban development initiatives in 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Thiruvananthapuram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thiruvananthapuram** is the capital city of the Indian state of **Kerala**.
 
• The city has been recognized for its **sustainable urban development initiatives**, which aim to make the urban environment more livable and eco-friendly.
 
• It has implemented several **green initiatives** such as waste management programs, promotion of renewable energy, and enhancing green cover in the city.
 
• The urban development in Thiruvananthapuram focuses on **inclusive growth** ensuring that all sections of society benefit from development efforts.
 
• Thiruvananthapuram has also been working on **smart city projects** that integrate technology to improve city governance and infrastructure.
 
• The city’s initiatives align with the **United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** to create sustainable cities and communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Doha**__

 __
 
• **Doha** is the capital city of **Qatar**.
 
• It is known for its rapid urban development and **modern architecture**.
 
• Doha has hosted several **international conferences** and events, including the **2022 FIFA World Cup**.
 
 
 
• **Agadir**__
 __
 
• **Agadir** is a city located in **Morocco**.
 
• It is known for its **beaches** and **tourism industry**.
 
• The city was rebuilt after a major earthquake in **1960**.
 
 
 
• **Melbourne**__
 
 
• **Melbourne** is a major city in **Australia**.
 
• It is renowned for its **cultural diversity**, **arts**, and **education**.
 
• Melbourne consistently ranks high in **global livability indices**.
